title: 📊 Daily Report: Mon Nov 9, 2026
text:
The swing book closed at $17,827.85. For the week it's up $8.93 against Monday's base: the strategies are up $8.93 and CORE QQQ is unchanged. Since the merge the book is down 10.95% ($2,192.89), while Indy (the SPY buy-and-hold benchmark) is down 3.32% ($664.79), so we're trailing by $1,528.10.

Sunny traded today, buying 1 share of MPC at $390.35 and 1 share of PSX at $251.60. No positions were closed. Sunny is the only active bot; Trek and Rota have no edge, and the rest are benched. There are 5 open positions. CORE QQQ is off (in cash) with the trend filter out — prior close 656.1 vs the 200-day at 679.79. Idle cash earned $5.26 in interest today (weekend plus Monday).

Research's analyst note for today:
- Best day since April: S&P +2.3%, Dow +2.2%, Nasdaq +2.7%, as Brent slid ~6% on Iran de-escalation talk and investors bought back last week's AI rout.
- Chips split hard: AMD jumped on an Oppenheimer upgrade and MPWR, AMAT, AVGO, MU all rallied, while NVDA fell ~4% on the board probe tied to Jensen Huang.
- Our NVDA avoid was right; the rest of the AI-hardware avoid missed a bounce, but we keep it through Tuesday since a first green day after a shock has been noise before.
- Energy lagged with oil; homebuilders were mixed. After hours, Trade Desk and Rocket Lab rose, Hims and Take-Two slipped.
- Next up: October CPI Tuesday 8:30 AM (core est. +0.2%), with December hike odds near 80%; CoreWeave reports Tuesday night. No new swing longs logged into CPI.
